title: Zhen Tai workers protest after being denied return to work
reason: VOD reports a real factory-gate protest and worker demand to return to work, but the documented demand is directed at the employer; no demand to the Cambodian state or a state policy is reported.
notes: The article says around 900 workers were affected by suspension; it does not clearly quantify simultaneous attendees. Preserve as a relevant non-state-target labor action, not an eligible state-directed mobilization.
